text:
Leo: hi all, jumping into my first night rotation and i'm immediately blocked. trying to open the night-runbook at https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/night but the browser keeps redirecting to /sso/login and then back in a loop. i've tried chrome + firefox and incognito.
Priya: ugh, welcome to the fun part :grimacing: — @Leo can you paste the full redirect URL you see? sometimes corp SSO sends you to the wrong tenant if you have multiple accounts. also: which VPN (corp-vpn or none)?
Leo: i'm on corp-vpn. redirect looks like: https://sso.redwood.ai/auth?state=...&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Frunbooks.redwood.ai%2Feng%2Foncall%2Fnight
Alex: that state loop usually means an expired session cookie cross-affects the SSO proxy. try removing runbooks-related cookies and the SSO cookie: clear site data -> then `open https://sso.redwood.ai/logout` -> re-login. if that fails i'll rotate the proxy certs for the night subdomain.
Leo: did the logout + clear cookies, still loop. i can access other internal apps fine.
Nora: tagging infra here — @Alex if you don't see an obvious cert issue, could the SSO group mapping for "eng-oncall-night" be missing? we had an incident where group sync failed and the runbook server returned an auth loop.
Alex: checking group sync... i see a delta: leo@redwood.ai is not in eng-oncall-night group (sync error at 2026-03-21T03:12Z). i'm pushing a manual sync now. give it ~30s and try again.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty  Schedule update: Leo added to schedule "eng-oncall-night" (pending). Please acknowledge your upcoming shifts.
Priya: also, quick heads up @Leo  the escalation contacts in the night runbook were not updated after last quarter. the DB escalation still points to Rob (left), so don't call that number. fallback is: page db-team (service: db-oncall) or call the infra pager at +1-555-0107. i'm pinging @Nora to confirm the right contact.
Leo: thanks, i didn't want to call Rob. can someone confirm how to page db-team from PD? i only see a service but no phone number.
Nora: in PD, open the incident, click "Notify a team", select "DB Team" and hit call. the phone number is behind the team tab: +1-555-0144 (db-oncall). i also added a note in the runbook: "do not use +1-555-0123".
Alex: sync finished, @Leo try the runbook link now. if still stuck try `curl -i -L https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/night` from a corp machine, see if the tunnel redirects to an error page (paste the output).
Leo: link loads now, runbook is visible. thanks! pasted curl output earlier but working in browser too. one more thing: the runbook shows version v1.2.0 but PD incident template references v1.4.3 steps for throttling — which is canonical for tonight?
Priya: canonical is v1.4.3; we didn't push a tag to runbooks UI due to a docs publishing hiccup. i'm attaching a short diff in the doc. for tonight follow the v1.4.3 throttling section (search for "token-burst" mitigation). i'll follow up with a quick doc push so versions match.
Leo: acknowledged. also i didn't receive mobile push for PD alerts for test page. anyone else have tips for PD push on Android?
Nora: double-check PD app notifications + background data. if push fails, PD falls back to SMS which is enabled on your profile. FYI we have a secondary contact (pager) that will call if both push+sms fail.
oncall-bot: Incident Simulator  A 20m sim for "night-rotation onboarding" is scheduled for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Participants: Priya, Nora, Leo, Alex. Please confirm attendance.
Priya: i'm in for the sim. dropping a calendar invite now.
Alex: i'll join and walk through the SSO troubleshooting steps and show the `id` check on the bastion for group membership.
Leo: thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick responses. confirmed for the sim and i'll ack the PD schedule. feel much better now :thumbsup:
